This low-stakes diagnostic samples every subject domain. Work without notes,
show reasoning on paper, and choose **I am not sure yet** rather than guessing.
The result is a study recommendation, not a grade or selection decision.

## Before you begin

- Allow about 60 minutes and pause if fatigue would distort the result.
- Use a calculator only when an item explicitly asks for approximation.
- Record confidence before checking feedback.
- Review the explanation even when your answer is correct.

<fc-quiz data-source="../../quizzes/pathway/diagnostic.yml">
  <p><strong>JavaScript-free option:</strong> read the questions and solutions in
  the generated Colab lesson or the printable item bank.</p>
</fc-quiz>

## Interpret the result

Treat each missed item as evidence about a skill mode: conceptual,
manual-calculation, symbolic-reasoning, computational, or interpretation. Begin
with the earliest prerequisite course containing repeated gaps, not necessarily
the course with the lowest raw score.
